setupHint.tmux: Start pi inside tmux (`tmux new -A -s pi 'pi'`).
setupHint.zellij: Start pi inside zellij (`zellij --session pi`, then run `pi`).
setupHint.herdr: Start herdr in your terminal (`herdr`), split a pane (prefix+v or prefix+-), then run `pi` in that pane. herdr auto-injects HERDR_ENV=1 + HERDR_PANE_ID for pi to detect.
setupHint.otty: Run pi inside Otty (Otty sets TERM_PROGRAM=otty automatically).
setupHint.orca: Run pi inside Orca (Orca sets TERM_PROGRAM=Orca and ORCA_TERMINAL_HANDLE automatically).
setupHint.generic: Start pi inside Muxy, cmux (`cmux pi`), tmux (`tmux new -A -s pi 'pi'`), zellij (`zellij --session pi`, then run `pi`), WezTerm, herdr (run `herdr`, split a pane, then run `pi` in it), Otty (Otty sets TERM_PROGRAM=otty automatically), or Orca (Orca sets TERM_PROGRAM=Orca automatically).
setupHint.herdrPreferred: Start pi inside herdr (HERDR_ENV=1 must be set; run herdr, then start pi in a pane).
setupHint.ottySendKeys: Otty's `ipc-allow-send-keys` is disabled. To let pi drive subagent panes, add `ipc-allow-send-keys = true` to ~/.config/otty/config.toml and reload Otty.
error.invalidHerdrMode: Unsupported Herdr surface mode: {value}. Choose split or tab.
rename.invalidContext: Invalid terminal rename ownership context; terminal names were not changed.
rename.missingId: Cannot determine the terminal rename target ID.
